hotspots.title: Turning Point USA Campus Cane Attack Controversy
hotspots.blurb: Coverage surrounding a violent altercation at the University of Texas at Tyler, where a suspect allegedly attacked Turning Point USA student organizers with a cane, has exploded across right-wing media. Conservative commentators and media outlets are framing the incident as evidence of escalating political hostility and violence targeted at young conservative activists on college campuses.
hotspots.affect: This story commands intense affective investment by validating conservative victimization narratives regarding left-wing violence on university campuses.

hotspots.title: Italy Mass School Bomb Threats & Meloni Summit
hotspots.blurb: A massive campaign of false bomb threats targeting over 6,000 Italian schools has created national anxiety and prompted Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni to call emergency talks with opposition leaders. Meloni has stressed political unity against intimidation while clashing with critics over proposed national budget measures.
hotspots.affect: High alarmist framing and security anxiety drive disproportionate coverage as national leaders maneuver amidst widespread public panic.

hotspots.title: Santiago Abascal & David Broncano TV Clash
hotspots.blurb: Following a bitter clash with public television host David Broncano and Spanish media outlets, Vox leader Santiago Abascal abruptly cancelled scheduled podcast appearances, including a high-profile interview with Jordi Wild. The decision has sparked fierce debate and internal criticism within Vox, exposing strategic rifts within the right-wing party's media strategy.
hotspots.affect: The controversy feeds into deep-seated right-wing distrust of mainstream broadcasting alongside intra-party grievance and media feuding.

hotspots.title: House GOP Impeachment Push Against Pete Hegseth
hotspots.blurb: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth continues to draw aggressive coverage over legislative attempts by House Democrats to file impeachment resolutions against him for military actions in Latin America and the Middle East. Meanwhile, Hegseth faced renewed scrutiny following reports of a public reprimand over conduct at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier.
hotspots.affect: High partisan friction and moral accusation keep Defense Department leadership in a state of high-conflict reporting.

hotspots.title: Pope Leo XIV & Javier Milei Dueling Visions Clash
hotspots.blurb: Repercussions from Pope Leo XIV's critique of free-market extremism continue to reverberate across Argentine political coverage. The clash has fueled ongoing tension within Javier Milei's administration, prompting defense efforts from pro-government media and maneuvering between key figures in La Libertad Avanza.
hotspots.affect: The moral and ideological weight of papal commentary directly challenges the core tenets of Milei's libertarian agenda, keeping affective tension high.
